parsed.rationale: Although `is_sample_app` is marked false on both records, the second member's file path `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` places it unambiguously inside an `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app location. The duplication of `MetricRow.body` in that file is almost certainly a local copy made to keep the sample app self-contained and runnable in isolation, not an accidental divergence. Lifting the production `DebugPanel` implementation into a shared location to satisfy this cluster would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. The `is_sample_app` flag appears to be a metadata gap rather than a deliberate override.
